registration.method: One full-cell transform for tabletop, feet, rack, phials, glass loops and masks; no independently fitted tall glass bounds.

palette.neutral_preview: Both layers are equal RGB; cyan extraction aid is removed. Glass reflections inherit glass ownership, not wood tint.

state_owner: One fixed tile; child deletes inherited empty/full tile/detail tags. Do not replace this fixture with generic empty/full Table art on inventory interaction.
fixture_boundary: Phial rack and alembic are described source bitmap fixtures. Actual carried inventory is separate native state, not additional baked objects.
native_behavior: Keep actual container/inventory, cover, non-occlusion and physics. No donor crafting/drug/research behavior. Rare animated/custom states retain native fallback.
